status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: Coin Metrics community data (github.com/coinmetrics/data, csv/<asset>.csv, last commit 2026-05-24) downloaded for the 473 of 490 ever-W200 perps whose base asset has a file. Only the column headers were counted (CapMrktEstUSD in 392 files, ReferenceRateUSD 442, AdrActCnt 55, CapMVRVCur 52, exchange flows 2). No value of any column has been read into a signal or compared with returns.
requested_by: 동동, 2026-11-20 '기준을 통과하는 전략이 나올때까지 계속 돌려 멈추지 말고'. Round 4 of that loop.

already_tested_not_repeated: token unlock schedules were 'absent' in ADR 0060: this is the first supply series
new_here: first on-chain / fundamental source in this archive: Coin Metrics community data
implied circulating supply = CapMrktEstUSD / ReferenceRateUSD; its growth = token issuance / unlock / inflation proxy
speculative turnover = perp quote volume / market cap
active address growth and MVRV for the subset of chains that have them

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.
universe: exactly ADR 0047/0096-0098 (U50/W200 by 30-day mean perp quote volume >= 2M USDT, >=60 bars, cut-off bar i-2). Coin Metrics asset = perp base with a leading 1000/1000000/1M prefix removed, lowercased (coinmetrics_map.json); only rows dated inside the DEV segments are read

segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid; trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding

quintile_rule: names of the universe with a signal; K = floor(n_with_signal / 5); need n_with_signal >= 10 (else flat); equal weight 1/(2K) per name

trials.SI1_SUPPLY28_U50: ln(supply[cut] / supply[cut-28]), supply = CapMrktEstUSD / ReferenceRateUSD (both > 0); long the LOWEST growth, short the highest
trials.TO1_TURNOVER_MCAP_U50: ln(mean perp quote volume cut-27..cut / mean CapMrktEstUSD cut-27..cut) (>= 20 days); long the LOWEST
trials.AA1_ACTIVE_ADDR_U50: ln(mean AdrActCnt cut-27..cut / mean AdrActCnt cut-55..cut-28) (>= 20 days each); long the HIGHEST
trials.MV1_MVRV_U50: CapMVRVCur at cut (latest value within 3 days); long the LOWEST

cost: ADR 0041 calibrated cost 'cal' decides; cal_x2, cal_tail_x2 conditions; cost0 reference
decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0098; DSR N=6 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 over the 6 S1 series reported
known_limits_written_before_results: Coin Metrics community history may be revised after the fact (not point-in-time); market cap estimate and supply can be backfilled. A DEV_PROMISING here would need a point-in-time forward check before anything else. AA1/MV1 cover about 50 chains of 490 names, so their universe-with-signal is small.
power_note_written_before_results: about 64 S1 rebalances over 2.4 years; MDE at 80% (Bonferroni 0.05/6) about 2.1; cumulative-N null max about 2.5
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +6 regardless.
